Fields.Name: Call ID
Fields.Description: The attack, projectile or effect this ring calls. Call ID Type picks which list it comes from.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Which visual effect plays for this ring. None keeps the default look.

Fields.Name: Weight (kg)
Fields.Description: How much this ring adds to your Equip Load.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: The Behavior ID linked to this ring. Its effect while equipped is not established.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Price
Fields.Description: Probably does nothing. Only weapons and armor can be reinforced.

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: How many souls feeding this ring to Kingseeker Frampt grants.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Where this ring sits in menu lists. Lower values sort first.

Fields.Name: World Tendency ID
Fields.Description: Probably unused in Dark Souls. It drove World Tendency in Demon's Souls.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: The model number for this ring. Its visible effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Which menu icon this ring shows.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Unknown. How shops use levels is not established.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The achievement tied to this ring. The exact list is not established.

Fields.Name: Sequential Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The sequential achievement tied to this ring. The exact list is not established.

Fields.Name: Model Category
Fields.Description: Which model group this ring uses. Its visible effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Model Gender
Fields.Description: Whether this ring's model is male or female. Its visible effect is not established.

Fields.Name: Call ID Type
Fields.Description: Which list the call ID comes from: attacks, projectiles or effects.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Which attacks this ring counts as, for buffs that raise one kind. Set None when no buff needs it.

Fields.Name: Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the Vagrant this ring may become. -1 spawns none, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Good Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the extra creature a Good Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Evil Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the creature an Evil Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Is Depositable
Fields.Description: Whether the player can move this ring into storage.

Fields.Name: Destroy on Unequip
Fields.Description: Whether taking this ring off destroys it.

Fields.Name: Block Drop in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Whether drops of this ring stay out of other players' worlds.
